price_factor._about: stored price = traded price x f; f parsed with fractions.Fraction. Segments: each applies from 'start' (inclusive; null = from the start of the panel) until the next segment's start.

tick_tables._about: traded yen; each row is [inclusive upper bound, tick]; a traded price above the last bound is refused

fine.in_force: TOPIX100 from 2015-09-24; TOPIX500 from September 2023 at the latest

dev_table._about: the table in force during dev; segments as in price_factor

flag4_windows._about: kept rows dated before the date are inside the window
